criteria.name: Opener
criteria.goodLooksLike: States who you are fast and asks permission; no "sorry to bother you"

anchors.1: Apologetic or rambling start ("sorry to bother you"); she has to ask who is calling
anchors.3: Says who they are and why, but slowly, or without asking for a moment of her time
anchors.5: Name, company and a permission ask within the first two sentences, brief and confident

criteria.name: Reason for call
criteria.goodLooksLike: A problem she'd recognise for her role; not a company or feature blurb

anchors.1: A company or feature blurb with nothing about her world
anchors.3: A generic problem that could apply to anyone
anchors.5: A specific problem someone in her role would recognise, in her terms, that earns the next minute

criteria.name: Discovery
criteria.goodLooksLike: Open questions, follow-ups on her answers, uncovers the private facts

anchors.1: No questions, or only closed and leading ones; talks at her
anchors.3: Some open questions but little follow-up; uncovers one private fact
anchors.5: Open questions that build on her answers; uncovers most of the private facts

criteria.name: Objections
criteria.goodLooksLike: Acknowledge → ask → answer → check; no arguing

anchors.1: Argues with, ignores or talks over her objections
anchors.3: Acknowledges and answers, but skips the clarifying question or the check
anchors.5: Acknowledges, asks a clarifying question, answers briefly, checks it landed

criteria.name: Next step
criteria.goodLooksLike: Asks for a specific day and time and confirms it

anchors.1: No ask, or a vague "can I send you some information?"
anchors.3: Asks for a meeting but leaves the day or time open
anchors.5: Proposes a specific day and time, gets a yes, and confirms it back

criteria.name: Delivery
criteria.goodLooksLike: Pace 130–170 wpm, at most 2 core fillers a minute, no monologue over 45 s, talk ratio 40–60%

anchors.1: Rushed or halting, frequent fillers, long monologues, dominates the talk time
anchors.3: Mostly steady, with some fillers or one long monologue
anchors.5: Steady pace, few fillers, short turns and a balanced share of the talking
